_what: Brief 5 D0 -- per-zone tree-density multiplier map (256 m bins).
_zone_rule: 512 m station cull-discs (forest_floor, plaza, treeline); bin cap = min over containing discs; outside all discs = target m; 128 m linear blend across each disc edge; per-station cap = min(budget cap, target). Ryan ruling 2026-09-22.

_sources.budgets: forest_floor 13.0 (R5-1 desk revision 2026-09-22), 0.1 ms desk margin -> cap solves 12.90; treeline tol 7.7; plaza 10.5

forest_floor.cap_basis: current headroom (no T4 rung PASSED the gate); 0.1 ms desk margin below budget

summary._note_treeline_plaza: plaza and treeline caps both == target 5.48 (their budget caps 12.31 / 7.72 exceed the target ceiling), so ONLY the forest_floor disc (cap 2.378) constrains a bin below target. Their discs are recorded in discs_containing but do not lower m.

vista._note: viewpoint, not a budget station; sees the forest only as HLOD (item8 ~1%). m_applied is the zone value at its XY.
